'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
